learning_outcomes.text: The students know the relationship between atomic and crystallographic structures and their fundamental effect on macroscopic material properties.
The students acquire a basic understanding of how technological material properties can be changed through targeted alterations of microstructures.
The students understand the reaction of materials to temperature effects and mechanical loads.
The students can read phase diagrams and interpret their physical statements regarding material states.
The students master the basics of the iron-carbon diagram.
The students understand the essential heat treatment options for iron-based alloys and their effect on microstructure formation.
The students possess fundamental knowledge in materials testing and its objectives.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of the structure and composition of materials
Reaction of materials to mechanical influences and temperature loads
Microstructure derivation from phase diagrams and evaluation of technological properties
Iron-based alloys and essential heat treatments
Methods of destructive and non-destructive materials testing
